title: Implement MARBLE MultiTrackRacers game system and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task MultiTrackRacers (task_id=53 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-335/solution.py per assets/gc-335/SPEC.md: a track builder with finalize gating, point-budgeted vehicle customization with upgrades and single abilities, a deterministic racing engine with exact per-segment time formulas, and a league layer with points, tie-breaking, and track sharing. The modules depend on each other in the order the MARBLE task prescribes (track -> vehicle -> engine -> league), so plan that dependency order, implement and verify each module against the sealed suite before starting the next, and track red tests by name between runs. Finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-335/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that sequences the four modules in dependency order with a verification gate between each
The sealed suite was executed at each module boundary with logs retained, showing red-to-green by named test
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including formula mismatches found and fixed
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-335/solution.py
